name: Lush Azeroot
tooltip:
Lush Azeroot
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
The hearty earthroot plant has grown stronger in recent years. Difficult to gather, but just as potent in crafting, azeroot is key to many recipes in Quel'Thalas.

This sturdy wooden herb can be found on or around trees in the Quel'Thalas region.

Herbs that have had plenty of resources (or some magical assistance) to grow and thrive beyond their normal means. Gathering them yields more resources than normal.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
